name: Yusician
tagline: Turns a style and a lyric into a finished song, rendered locally
description: Produces a complete track from a style note and a set of words, running the music model on your own Apple-silicon hardware instead of in somebody else's cloud, and returning a high-sample-rate audio file. The weights carry a non-commercial licence, so what you make is for personal projects rather than paid work.
author: monomyth
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
